prompt: elixir to_timeout Duration year month fields constraint
answer:
`to_timeout/1` does not support `Duration` values with nonzero `:year` or `:month` fields. Those fields must be set to `0`; otherwise, it raises because years and months cannot be reliably converted to milliseconds.

It supports durations only up to weeks (with weeks converted to days).
